transcript.answer: I found the threshold in the specs but not in the code. It is a cosine similarity of 0.92. When a newly extracted fact scores at or above 0.92 against an existing valid fact, the old fact is invalidated. Its `valid_to` is set, `invalidated_by` is linked, and a row is written to `memory.fact_conflicts`. The spec in `specs/temporal-fact-invalidation/spec.md` (FR-2.3) says the value is configurable through the `LORE_FACT_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD` env var, defaulting to 0.92. The same 0.92 appears in `specs/2-agent-memory/spec.md`, `specs/1-lore-platform/spec.md` (FR-11.5) and `specs/2-agent-memory/tasks.md` (T062). The specs tie the detection logic to `libs/server-core/src/work/memory/facts.ts`. I could not open that file, so I haven't confirmed the constant is defined there.
